title: 艾尼维亚·冰峰长翼
description: 冰晶凤凰立在宽阔冰峰平台，双翼舒展但不俯冲，蓝色羽晶在强侧光下呈现层次分明的切面。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Anivia is a majestic ice phoenix with layered crystalline blue feathers, a long avian neck, pointed icy crest, expansive wings, and long angular tail feathers. Preserve correct bird anatomy, two grounded taloned feet, and her unmistakable frozen plumage rather than a humanoid body. Her bright eyes are composed, and the crystalline forms have clear drawn facets without threatening splinters or injured creatures.
art_direction.scene: Place her on a broad frozen summit ledge with both feet secure and wings opened in a measured ceremonial span, not a diving attack. The full wing and tail silhouette fits within the square. A distant range drops into pale atmospheric layers, while a single hard sunrise separates ice-blue wax strokes from indigo shadows and an uncluttered winter sky.
art_direction.palette: ice blue, cobalt, snowy ivory, pale sunrise gold
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
